definition: Niceaunties is the pseudonym of a Singapore-based artist and designer whose work incorporates generative artificial intelligence, video, and digital installation.
details: Her practice centers around the figure of the "auntie", a common term for older women in Southeast Asian contexts, and explores themes such as aging, care, domesticity, and gender roles. Her work has been featured in exhibitions and media platforms including TED, Christie's Art + Tech, Expanded.Art, and publications such as The Guardian, The Straits Times.

explainer.lead: Niceaunties is the pseudonym of a Singapore-based artist and designer working with generative AI, video and digital installation. Her work matters for centering the Southeast Asian "auntie" figure and themes of aging, care, domesticity and gender roles.

tiers.eli5: An artist makes pictures and videos with AI help, starring the kind of older auntie you see all over Southeast Asia.
tiers.practitioner: Creators working in this mode combine generative AI with video and installation rather than treating AI output as the final piece. A pitfall is assuming the work is purely machine-made, when it is an authored practice built around a specific cultural figure.
tiers.paperLevel: No formal definition applies; it is an artist pseudonym and body of work spanning generative AI, video and digital installation, with no stated metric or bound.

explainer.example: A gallery piece might pair AI-generated images of aunties with video and a physical installation, shown at venues such as Christie's Art + Tech.
